headline: Argentina Records $3.39 Billion October Trade Surplus on Record Exports
summary: Argentina posted a monthly trade surplus of $3.39 billion in October as export revenues hit an all-time high, surpassing the total export value achieved during all of 2025 in just 10 months.
why: Argentina relies heavily on trade surpluses to rebuild depleted central bank foreign exchange reserves and meet external debt obligations.

impacts.name: Argentine Peso
impacts.why: A robust trade surplus provides hard currency to help support foreign reserve levels.
